dict.string: Heirloom records short voice notes that stay on this device. Nothing leaves the archive.
Heirloom uses your camera to capture photos and a reference selfie for face recognition. Everything stays on this device.
Heirloom lets you add photos from your library to the archive. They stay on this device.
Heirloom can save photos to your library if you choose to export them. Nothing else is shared.
